Dani Olmo is pure class!
Elegant on the ball, incredibly creative and always a threat in the final third – Dani Olmo has everything you need to be a game-changer. With his outstanding technique, clever movement and eye for goal, the Spaniard became one of the Bundesliga's most exciting players. Sit back and enjoy his best moments in a RB Leipzig shirt! What’s your favourite Dani Olmo moment? Let us know in the comments!
